subject: reasoning
question: Which of the following is/are identical to the address given below:Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001?

options.text: Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001
Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurugram, 122001
Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122002
Rohit Kumar, Flat 12-A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001

solution:
Address given:Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001

Identical to the address given,

**Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001 - Match.**

Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, __Gurugram,__ 122001 - Not match

Rohit Kumar, Flat 12A, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, __122002 __- Not Match

Rohit Kumar, __Flat 12-A__, Maple Heights, Sector 45, Gurgaon, 122001 - Not Match

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
